profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer III
profile.summary: I have garnered experience in industries such as of EV startups and Space & Defense. My roles and skill sets include Electrical Systems integration, Hardware-in-Loop Testing, Automation software, Software Release Management, Diagnostic Protocols, Power Electronics, NI LabVIEW, and Embedded Software development in C/C++.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded Software Engineer for in-house propulsion ECUs.
- SW development in C/C++
- TI microcontrollers and Arm Cortex R4, R5 processors.
- Micrium RTOS
- CAN communication, UDS protocols
- HAL driver development and debugging (CAN, SPI, Flash, PWM, ADC)
- Data sheet reading
- Schematics reading
- JTAG debugging

positions.title: Power Electronics Design Release Engineer
positions.description: DRE for power electronic components such as DCDC, On-Board Charger, and Charge Control Module. Lead design and software development for end-of-line and DVP&R test stands based on LabVIEW.

positions.title: Lead, Software Management EE Systems I & V
positions.description: Lead engineer for software release process and electrical systems integration and validation.

positions.title: Engineer, EE Systems Integration & HIL Application
positions.description: Electrical Systems and HIL Application Engineer

positions.title: EE Systems and HIL Engineer Intern
Student Assistant
positions.description:
Mentor high school students in STEM disciplines.
Teach introduction to Arduino and coding.

positions.title: AppCamp/FabCamp Lead Instructor
positions.description: I worked under two camps, AppCamp and FabCamp.  In AppCamp I taught middle school and high school students an introduction to computer programming concepts using  hands on projects made from Scratch, Arduino, AppInventor, and Raspberyy Pi.  In FabCamp  I taught middle school and high school students basic circuits, hardware, soldering on PCB boards, software, and coding Python with Raspberry Pi.

honors.title: 2nd Place National Prosthetic Arm Challenge
honors.issuer: Issued by MESA - Math, Engineering, Science Achievement · Jun 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: During my time in Key Club, I volunteered and led many service projects including the Happiness Project, Kelly's Closet, and PB&J drive.  The Happiness Project, which takes place during the holidays, gives me an opportunity to fill the less fortunate youth with the holiday spirit and help them enjoy their Christmas. Kelly's Closet is an event where I get to take impoverished children back to school shopping and provide them with the supplies and encouragement to tackle the new school year. The PB&J drive I help orchestrate is an opportunity to rally my community to help feed the local homeless.
I help serve mass and train other altar servers.

projects.title: Solar Car Telemetry
projects.description:
Designed architecture for CAN-bus communication among control units such as Battery Management
System, Motor Controller and Solar Charger Controller. Developed embedded system for central in-
formation unit and GUI for dashboard display using Raspberry Pi, Python, and Qt GUI framework.

projects.title: IoT Irrigation System
projects.description:
Created small scale, smart irrigation system using Raspberry Pi and Python. Managed multi-threading
to control temperature/humidity sensor, relay to activate sprinkler motor, web scraping data from
weather station, calculation of watering time each hour, and display data on LCD screen.
